question: Kathakali primarily originated from which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathakali** is a traditional **dance-drama **form that originated in the state of **Kerala** in southwestern India.
 
• It is believed to have developed in the **17th century, **and combines elements of **dance, drama, music, and ritual.**
 
• The word "Kathakali" comes from two Malayalam words: **"katha" (story) and "kali" (performance)**.
 
• The elaborate costumes, makeup, and facial expressions used in Kathakali performances are distinctive and help to convey the** emotions and characters** of the story being told.
 
• Kathakali has become popular not just in Kerala but also in other parts of India and around the world, as a **unique and captivating** form of theatrical art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka** is a neighboring state of **Kerala**, and has its own rich tradition of classical dance forms such as **Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.**
 
• **Andhra Pradesh**, located further to the east, is known for its own dance forms such as **Kuchipudi and Vilasini Natyam.**
 
• **Tamil Nadu**, located to the east of Kerala, is known for its own classical dance forms such as **Bharatanatyam and Mohiniyattam.**
 
 
• There is a similar dance-drama form called "**Therukoothu**" that is popular in Tamil Nadu and shares some similarities with Kathakali.
